name: prophasis
description: See how your code connects: functions, methods and classes as cards with numbered arrows. Explore calls, callers, uses and types, and explain any path in plain language.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Explain is turned off in untrusted workspaces, because it sends code to a language model. The graph works.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Prophasis needs a language server with call hierarchy, which virtual workspaces usually do not have.

prophasis.defaultDepth.description: How many levels of calls to load when a graph opens. 1 shows the starting point and what it calls directly; you can expand any card from there.

prophasis.maxCards.description: Most cards shown at once. Anything beyond this is counted in a "more not shown" note.

prophasis.showExternalCode.description: Show calls into library and standard-library code (for example JSON.stringify or len).

prophasis.excludeGlobs.markdownDescription: File patterns to leave out of the graph, relative to the workspace folder. Example: `**/test/**`.

prophasis.explain.includeBodies.description: For "Explain" on a class: send the method bodies too, not only one line per member. Gives fuller answers but sends more code.

prophasis.explain.maxCharacters.description: Most characters of code sent in one Explain request. Longer code is cut to fit.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Prophasis
walkthroughs.description: See how your code connects, as cards and arrows, in a few clicks.

steps.title: Show the flow of a function
steps.description:
Open a TypeScript, JavaScript or Python file and click **Show flow** above any function, method or class. You can also right-click inside one, or press Ctrl+Shift+Alt+F.
[Show flow at the cursor](command:prophasis.showFlow)

steps.title: Explore in any direction
steps.description: Every card has buttons: **Calls →** (what it calls), **← Called by** (what calls it), **Used by**, and on classes **Extends**. Click a card to open its code. Click a lit button again to hide what it showed.

steps.title: Read the arrows
steps.description: Numbers show the order calls are written in the code (not always the order they run). Dashed arrows are uses and type relations. ↻ marks recursion. Press **?** in the panel for the legend.

steps.title: Explain in plain language (optional)
steps.description: Hover a card and click **✦ Explain**, or right-click a card for **Explain path from start to here**. It uses GitHub Copilot through VS Code and asks before sending any code.

scripts.check:engine: npm run build && node test/feasibility/runProbe.mjs engineCheck
scripts.check:panel: npm run build && node test/feasibility/runProbe.mjs panelCheck
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/notices.mjs --check && vsce package --no-dependencies
